Today, my bipartisan legislation to rename the Olney Post Office in memory of Sgt. Ed Ramsey passed the Senate's @HSGAC.

Ed worked at the Olney Post Office joyously for 27 years after serving in the Army. I'm grateful to @ChrisVanHollen and @Sen_Alsobrooks for their partnership to honor this patriot. We're one step closer to this locally significant bill becoming law.

posts.text: I served with Karen Montgomery for many years in the Maryland State Senate and counted on her always as a good friend with a warm sense of humor. She was a strong and unswerving progressive leader on everything from marriage equality to abolition of the death penalty to strong support for public education and the Chesapeake Bay. I will miss her and think of her always with great affection and appreciation. May her memory be a blessing to her wonderful family and friends. bethesdamagazine.com/202
